title: Orange Falling Crosshair
description: An orange crosshair resource pack. Made by Uquwaity
body:
# 🍊 Orange Falling Crosshair

Orange Falling Crosshair is a stylish resource pack that replaces the standard Minecraft crosshair with a custom, **spinning orange**. Inspired by the famous "spinning tomato" crosshair used by various YouTubers, this pack adds a fresh and juicy look to your game!

### ✨ Features:

* **Animated Design:** Features a smooth, spinning orange animation.
* **Two Versions:** Includes both Normal and Inverted versions for perfect visibility on any background.
* **Lightweight:** Minimalistic and optimized, it won't affect your FPS.
* **Highly Compatible:** Works perfectly with most other resource packs.

### 🛠 Compatibility & Versions:

The pack is fully updated and supports:
* **Legacy versions:** Minecraft 1.21.11 and older.
* **Modern versions:** Fully compatible with the new **26.1.x** release cycle.

**Created by:** Uquwaity

*Hope you enjoy this "Orange" style in your world!*
